statements.t: We announced another record quarter, closed our acquisition of LivePerson, and guided that the company will be adjusted EBITDA profitable within the second half of 2027,” said Keyvan Mohajer, CEO and Co-Founder of SoundHound AI.

• The Company has been strategically non-renewing and exiting certain negative gross margin contracts inherited from prior acquisitions and expects to continue doing so, with a positive impact on both gross margin and EBITDA.
The financial statements for the fiscal quarter will be posted on the website, and will also be filed as an exhibit when the company files its 8-K including this press release.

risks.t: risks and uncertainties impacting SoundHound’s business including
our ability to successfully launch and commercialize new products and services and derive significant revenue
our market opportunity and our ability to acquire new customers and retain existing customers
charges or expenses resulting from our recent acquisitions
the ability of our recent acquisitions to be accretive on the company's financial results
